title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: State Theatre, Easton | 2006
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the State Theatre in Easton, Pennsylvania, USA, on 11 July 2006.

It was the 18th show by the ninth All-Starr Band. Their tour of North America lasted for 25 dates in June and July 2006.

Starr had previously performed at the State Theatre on 30 July 2003. He returned there on 2 July 2010, 26 June 2012, and 9 September 2022.

The ninth All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Billy Squier: vocals, guitar
  • Richard Marx: vocals, guitar, keyboards
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Rod Argent: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar
  • Sheila E: vocals, drums, percussion
